messages:
Maria: Quick QA — final blog draft is up for final approvals. Pinged legal + design. Need to lock CTAs for webinar registration vs. benchmark download and confirm HubSpot routing. Draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize-launch-draft :spiral_note_pad:
Paul: Read through — copy is tight. Suggest hero primary CTA = 'See benchmarks' and secondary CTA = 'Join webinar' (helps capture intent). Also want UTMs standardized.
Elaine: Legal reviewed — minor tweaks. Avoid absolute comparative claims (no 'lowest cost' w/o a clear methodology). Replace 'cut costs by X%' with 'reduce per-token cost by ~X' and link to our benchmark appendix.
Sam: Design updates pushed — new hero screenshot + social card mock. Need final alt text and 1200x630 export.
Olivia: Ops note — webinar CTA should map to HubSpot form id `webinar_reg_2026`, benchmark CTA -> `benchmark_download_2026`. Add hidden field `campaign=optimize_launch` and tag for downstream routing.
Maria: Thanks — I've applied Elaine's language edits. Paul, can you paste the UTM string you want? Sam, can you deliver the social card by EOD?
Paul: Proposed UTM: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_v1&utm_content=bench_vs_webinar` — works for me. Also recommend an A/B: variant A primary CTA = benchmarks, variant B primary CTA = webinar for 3 days.
Elaine: Legal greenlight once the comparative language is fixed. Also flagged cookie/privacy snippet for benchmark data sample — please add a short note above the download CTA.
Olivia: I'll wire the HubSpot forms and create two workflows: `webinar_flow_2026` and `benchmark_flow_2026`. Plan: add lead score tag `benchmark_interest` for anyone who downloads. Will also add webhook to post to #sales-inbound.
Maria: Added the privacy blurb and moved CTA order per Paul's note. Quick checklist: legal ✅, copy ✅, design pending upload ✅ if Sam confirms, ops to confirm HubSpot wiring before publish.
Sam: Uploaded final social card: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/optimize-social-1200x630.png — alt text: "Redwood Inference: Reduce inference costs and speed up latency — see results"
Olivia: HubSpot forms and workflows created and tested with staging leads. Routing verified, test lead delivered to Sales queue. Webhook URL added for Slack notifications.
WebflowBot: Preview published: https://preview.redwood.ai/blog/optimize-launch-v2 — scheduled publish 2026-04-02 09:00 PT :rocket:
Maria: OK — scheduling looks good. Final run-through with growth at 08:45 PT, Paul will kick off A/B at 09:10 PT. If no objections I'll hit publish at 09:00. :thumbsup:
Paul: No objections. Go for it. :+1:
Maria: Thanks everyone — will follow up with publish post and initial metrics in this thread.
